...Awkward.
Not one word exchanged yet.

Muramasa must have things on her mind. Naturally. Remembering last night's disgrace made speech no easier for me. Naturally.

What to do?
I knew there was nothing for it but an abject apology...

……気詰まりだ。
　まだ一言も、言葉を交わしていない。

　村正としては、含むところがあるのだろう。当たり
前だ。
　俺としては、昨晩の醜態を思い起こすにつけ、口が
重くなるばかりだった。当たり前だが。

　どうしたものだろう。
　平謝りに謝るしかないのはわかっているのだが……。

en.html:
Muramasa"Listen."
Kageaki"...?"
Muramasa"Feeling... a little better?"
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"Yes. Perhaps..."
Muramasa"I see..."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"..."
Kageaki"Muramasa."
Muramasa"What?"
Kageaki"...About yesterday."
Muramasa"—"
Muramasa"Y-yes."
Kageaki"...Well..."
Kageaki"I am sorry."
Muramasa"..."
Kageaki"An apology hardly settles it..."
Muramasa"...It is all right. Don't worry."
Kageaki"I cannot simply do that."
Muramasa"...I..."
Muramasa"I mean, if you wanted help—"
Kageaki"In any case, I promise. That foolish behavior ends there."
Muramasa"...Eh?"
Kageaki"I shall never make you carry everything like that again."
